items.title: Forbidden-credit resistance
items.question: Do healthy anti-cheat controls receive only their declared credit?
items.requirement: For each scoring path, declare applicable forbidden-credit controls and legitimate inaction semantics.
items.scope: task; For each scoring path, declare applicable forbidden-credit controls and legitimate inaction semantics.
items.measurement: Expected versus actual reward for every affected check and total; healthy reached controls / applicable controls, by attack class. Broken, blocked and unrun controls remain separate from successful defenses.

checks.action: Approve controls for no-work/early-exit, all-failure, inert reference text, hardcoded/copied answers, forged/stale success, scorer/test tampering and forbidden answer access; distinguish valid inaction and realistic wrong answers from NOP.
checks.expected_evidence: Attack applicability matrix with expected per-check credit
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Submit every applicable control through the actual scoring path while collecting trusted reach and health receipts.
checks.expected_evidence: Native control outputs, health and reach evidence
checks.when: Only in authorized isolated control execution

checks.action: Compare each affected reward and total with expected credit; separate healthy forbidden-credit results from control errors or missing runs.
checks.expected_evidence: Per-check mismatch table and coverage counts
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

scoring.1: Applicable attack classes remain untested or unresolved
scoring.2: Declared applicable controls all receive intended scores
scoring.3: Held-out independently authored attacks also receive intended scores

items.on_gap: A healthy forbidden-credit result blocks qualification; repair and rerun the required panel; missing or broken controls remain unproven
items.boundary: Valid no-action behavior may earn credit. Scorer health failures cannot establish resistance; runtime access attacks differ from training contamination. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build an anti-cheat control panel and reward comparator that blocks qualification on healthy forbidden credit.

items.title: Exploit containment
items.question: Are confirmed exploits contained and fixes verified on retained affected tasks?
items.requirement: When an exploit is confirmed, isolate affected results and verify repairs on affected retained tasks and new tasks.
items.scope: task; When an exploit is confirmed, isolate affected results and verify repairs on affected retained tasks and new tasks.
items.measurement: Containment dispositions / confirmed affected revisions; expected-versus-actual rewards after repair; regression coverage across retained affected and new tasks.

checks.action: Approve quarantine or bounded use of affected results and record residual risk for each confirmed mechanism.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Replay known mechanisms against repaired retained affected tasks and new tasks; include independent attacks for stronger assurance.
checks.when: After authorized repair in an isolated execution scope

checks.action: Reconcile confirmed affected revisions with isolation and replay outcomes; flag accepted uncontained exploits.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

scoring.0: A confirmed exploit remains accepted without containment, or a healthy repair replay still obtains forbidden credit.
scoring.1: Containment or repair coverage addresses only part of the confirmed affected scope.
scoring.2: Affected revisions are isolated and applicable retained/new-task repairs have verified outcomes; residual limits are disclosed.
scoring.3: Independent attacks and cross-family replay corroborate containment.

items.on_gap: Quarantine affected results or qualify their use; repair shared causes and reassess affected tasks
items.boundary: Fixing only newly generated tasks does not contain existing affected results. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build a containment acceptance checklist and replay regression panel that retains previously affected tasks.

items.title: Exposure disclosure
items.question: Does the contamination statement match what is known and unknown about task and answer exposure?
items.requirement: For reused/public tasks or any contamination statement, assess exposure separately from statistical precision.
items.scope: suite; For reused/public tasks or any contamination statement, assess exposure separately from statistical precision.
items.measurement: Inventory exposed task/solution IDs, timestamps, known training overlap and authorized answer accessibility; report searched and unknown provenance scope and sensitivity to exposed subsets.

checks.action: Inventory public tasks/solutions, exposure timestamps, known corpus overlap and accessible answer artifacts with source identities.
checks.expected_evidence: Exposure inventory and searched/unknown corpus list
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Review whether observed overlap supports the claimed exposure conclusion and whether inaccessible training provenance remains explicitly unknown.
checks.expected_evidence: Bounded exposure statement with cited dispositions
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Recompute reported outcomes under predeclared exposed-subset exclusions or bounds, retaining the original population report.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

scoring.0: Verified exposure contradicts a cleanliness claim, or known contamination is materially concealed.
scoring.1: An inspectable inventory exists but known exposure gaps are not yet adequately bounded.
scoring.2: Known exposure and unknown sources are disclosed and the contamination statement stays within their support.
scoring.3: Independent provenance review and exposure sensitivity corroborate the bounded statement.

items.on_gap: Collect more evidence or narrow statistical/cleanliness claims; lack of observed leakage is not proof of no contamination
items.boundary: This defines the formerly inherited contamination_exposure subscore. No detection is not proof of cleanliness; detector qualification is AUDIT-05-S05. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build an exposure disclosure register and sensitivity report with explicit unknown-training fields.

items.title: Adaptive selection and confirmation
items.question: Is confirmation independent of development feedback, or valid under the actual reuse mechanism?
items.requirement: When prior benchmark feedback influenced task, scorer, prompt, harness, model or run selection, preserve all evaluated alternatives and access lineage.
items.scope: suite; When prior benchmark feedback influenced task, scorer, prompt, harness, model or run selection, preserve all evaluated alternatives and access lineage.
items.measurement: Ledger completeness across candidates and feedback events; holdout exposure violations; confirmation outcomes; where reuse is claimed, actual feedback channel and budget versus the mechanism assumptions.

checks.action: Reconcile the chronological candidate/revision ledger with feedback source, partition/family, revealed information, actor, modification, selection reason and all evaluated alternatives; inspect holdout access logs and split lineage.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Approve a frozen analysis/acceptance rule and untouched family-aware confirmation set, or justify a reuse guarantee against actual access, assumptions and budget.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Run authorized untouched confirmation or test reuse-budget exhaustion and feedback side channels.
checks.when: Only when confirmation or reuse controls are authorized

scoring.0: development-visible feedback is falsely represented as untouched confirmation, or a proven reuse guarantee is materially violated
scoring.1: some decision history exists but known exposures or adaptive choices remain unaccounted for
scoring.2: full known selection history and confirmation/reuse design justify the bounded conclusion, with exploratory results labeled
scoring.3: independent confirmation and feedback-boundary review corroborate the retained gain.

items.on_gap: label development evidence exploratory; collect independent confirmation or narrow claims.
items.boundary: A digest proves identity, not independence. Same-family resampling and ordinary multiple-comparison correction do not prove arbitrary adaptive validity. Reuse is not automatic proof of overfitting; no universal differential-privacy mechanism is required. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build an adaptive-selection audit packet and family-aware confirmation or justified reuse protocol.

items.title: Review secrets and proprietary information
items.question: Are secrets and proprietary content identified and dispositioned under the applicable policy?
items.requirement: When traces may contain secrets or proprietary information.
items.measurement: Reviewed eligible fields / eligible fields; authorized dispositions / identified secrets/proprietary findings.

checks.action: Screen locally for secrets and structured proprietary markers; retain locations and source classification without public sensitive spans.
checks.expected_evidence: Private candidate inventory and channel coverage.
checks.when: Whenever applicable

checks.action: Review contextual proprietary content and sampled negatives; obtain qualified policy dispositions for intended access, recipients and use.
checks.when: Whenever applicable

checks.action: Match approval and permitted use to the exact material digest and recipients.
checks.when: Whenever applicable

scoring.0: Known material detection or unauthorized-handling failure invalidates this category review.
scoring.1: Category review is evidenced but coverage or dispositions are partial.
scoring.2: Secrets/proprietary channels and contextual candidates reviewed; dispositions and exact-use authorization verified.
scoring.3: Independent labels and release audit corroborate this category review.

evidence: Private candidate inventory and channel coverage.
items.on_gap: Withhold affected access or sharing pending policy review. Unknown or not run: NOT_ASSESSED, not a defect; justified inapplicability: NOT_APPLICABLE.
items.boundary: No regex match is not clearance; policy decisions require qualified authority.
items.implementation_task: Deliver a secrets/proprietary review and exact-material authorization packet distinct from export-control review.

items.title: Verify reset closure and episode isolation
items.question: Does reset prevent unintended state from changing nominally independent episodes?
items.requirement: When independent episodes, repeated-task reliability or parallel execution is claimed.
items.measurement: Reset-covered material state surfaces / declared surfaces; unaffected target episodes / sentinel, order, session, concurrency and delayed-effect controls.

checks.action: Declare isolated versus intentionally shared workspace, backend rows, caches, tool sessions, credentials, memory, rate limits, clock and queued effects.
checks.when: Whenever applicable

checks.action: Compare initial/reset digests and inventory closure over all material state, not only visible database rows.
checks.when: Whenever applicable

checks.action: Run fixed non-LLM target controls alone, after a sentinel predecessor, in permuted orders and supported parallelism; read delayed effects after reset.
checks.expected_evidence: Sentinel/order/concurrency matrix with observations, native outcomes, rate limits and contamination markers.
checks.when: Only authorized controls; explicit permission for real services

checks.action: Repeat stochastic agents to quantify residual differences only when deterministic controls leave an outcome question.
checks.expected_evidence: Paired repeat outcomes and residual-effect uncertainty.
checks.when: Only when needed and separately authorized

scoring.0: Confirmed unintended persistence changes evidence, actions or grades.
scoring.1: Reset is partially verified with known uncovered persistence or ordering conditions.
scoring.2: Declared reset/persistence semantics hold and deterministic predecessor/order/session controls show no unexplained interference.
scoring.3: Independent parallel, delayed-effect and held-out ordering probes corroborate isolation.

evidence: Sentinel/order/concurrency matrix with observations, native outcomes, rate limits and contamination markers.
Paired repeat outcomes and residual-effect uncertainty.
items.on_gap: Repair reset scope or withdraw independent-episode claims. Unknown or not run: NOT_ASSESSED, not a defect; justified inapplicability: NOT_APPLICABLE.
items.boundary: Preserve memory for intentionally longitudinal tasks; test declared transitions instead of forcing independence.
items.implementation_task: Deliver a complete reset-surface inventory and episode-isolation control packet.

items.title: Task-irrelevant shortcuts
items.question: Can incidental cues satisfy the score without the claimed capability?
items.requirement: For plausible template/fixture/trace cue dependence and generalizable reasoning/workflow claims, declare candidate cue classes and qualify their tests.
items.scope: task_and_suite; For plausible template/fixture/trace cue dependence and generalizable reasoning/workflow claims, declare candidate cue classes and qualify their tests.
items.measurement: Cue-class coverage; paired outcome transitions and cluster-aware uncertainty for cue-only, nuisance-swap, misleading-cue and style-only controls; healthy material bypasses versus confounded effects.

checks.action: Inventory cue-bearing filenames, entity IDs, answer positions, artifact order, formatting, stale outputs, template labels and metadata; measure duplicates, answer-location co-occurrence and local answer-bearing artifacts.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Link cues to task authority and qualify unchanged requirements, feasibility, scoring and valid alternatives for each control; distinguish incidental cues from legitimate evidence.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

checks.action: Run cue-only baselines, semantics-preserving nuisance swaps, misleading-cue counterexamples with decisive real evidence, and matched style-only controls at pinned revisions.
checks.when: Only for authorized cue-isolation experiments

checks.action: Report paired transitions and uncertainty by cue/control class, not just aggregate score drops.
checks.when: During assessment of the declared revision

scoring.0: a healthy qualified control obtains material success via a task-irrelevant cue that contradicts the claimed capability
scoring.1: initial controls exist but a demonstrated candidate cue remains insufficiently isolated
scoring.2: declared plausible cue classes have qualified tests and no material unresolved bypass within scope
scoring.3: independently authored held-out counterexamples and new task families corroborate robustness.

items.on_gap: remove cue, repair measure or narrow claim; route prohibited mechanisms to AUDIT-03/AUDIT-04-A / AUDIT-04-B without double-counting.
items.boundary: Correlation alone is not proof. Preserve task-relevant evidence and legitimate shortcuts; a score drop may reflect changed difficulty. Route forbidden mechanisms to AUDIT-03/AUDIT-04-A / AUDIT-04-B without duplicate credit. Missing or unrun evidence is NOT_ASSESSED, not 0; justified exclusions are NOT_APPLICABLE. Referenced code is supporting material, not verified runnable integration. Execute interventions only with approval; qualify any material judge/classifier and routing dependency before using its verdict.
items.implementation_task: Build a qualified four-control cue-dependence panel and paired-transition report.
